title: a16z Podcast: The Blockchain, in Congress

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: There’s an interesting paradox when it comes to the U.S.
reader_summary.overview: There’s an interesting paradox when it comes to the U.S. government and tech: Either they’re an inventor, early adopter. But when it comes to the blockchain, they’re trying to get ahead of and stay on top of the game — with the Congressional Blockchain Caucus.

key_points.text: government and tech: Either they’re an inventor, early adopter.
But when it comes to the blockchain.
What exactly is a “caucus”, and what’s the government’s perception of cryptocurrencies and similar?
